Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 15875/2022 Vicky S/o Late Shri Kaluram, Aged About 19 Years, R/o Opposite Railway Station, Khatubadi, Dist. Nagaur (Raj.) (Presently Lodged At Sub Jail Merta City, Nagaur).
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Sunil Gurjar S/o Shri Sharwan Ram, Aged About 19 Years,
 R/o Asarwa, Ps Makrana, Dist. Nagaur.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 15875/2022
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mahaveer Bishnoi  Mr. Jayram Saran For Respondent(s) : Ms. Anita Gehlot, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 20/01/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.332/2022 registered at Police Station Makrana, District Nagaur, for offence under Sections 363, 366 a, 376 D, 376(2)(N) and 120-b of IPC and under Sections 5(g)(L)/6, 16/17 of POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as also the learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the only allegation levelled against the present petitioner is of driving an auto in which Goga (2 of 2) [CRLMB-15875/2022] Ram was dropped to the Village Khatu where the said incident has occurred.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that in view of the aforesaid submissions, no useful purpose would be served by keeping him behind the bars and the petitioner is deserve to be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.

Considering the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, this court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner-Vicky S/o Late Shi Kaluram shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 58-KshamaD/-
